senses.definition: A crystalline sulfonic acid, HOC₁₀H₅(SO₃H)₂, derived from beta naphthol and used as a dye intermediate; 2-naphthol-3,6-disulfonic acid.
Any month containing the letter r in its name, i.e. the months from September to April.
senses.example: You, know, September is an “R” month, so they should be good to go. He reached into the freezer that was still cool and took out a sack that had a few dozen raw oysters.

senses.definition: A curved form of the letter r, found in some medieval and fraktur scripts: ⟨ ꝛ ⟩.
senses.example: […] completely informed about the decisions made and the reasons to make them, e.g. r rotunda does not figure in the transcription as the use of straight r and r rotunda is governe

senses.definition: A vowel modified so that the frequency of its third formant is lowered.
senses.example: [ɚ] is an R-coloured vowel; its non-rhotacised form is [ə].
